description: Claude Code installs a marketplace directory source directly, so this host's bundle is the plugin itself. bundle_root is '.' because marketplace.template.json declares source './'; a host that nests its plugin inside the bundle sets this to that subdirectory. Every source is written repository-root-relative. resolve_source would also find an adapter-relative one - that fallback is what made ADR 0001 step 3 a pure git mv - but a mixture of the two spellings is what stopped render_agents.both_positions from matching a source to its placed copy, so the spelling is now uniform. roles/ and hosts/ are NOT development surface, although they look like it: the bundle ships validate_roles.py, render_agents.py and root_preflight.py, and all three read those manifests - along with adapters/<host>/agent-interface.json, which decides whether a delegating role may be built here at all, and layout.json, which is how a script inside the bundle learns where a source was placed. Only THIS host's capability manifest and interface ship: the other hosts name bundled_dir paths a Claude Code install has no reason to carry.
